# Kord Studio

> Kord is an AI mastering service for Indian independent artists and bedroom producers, made by Syntalix LLP. It turns a finished mix into release-ready masters for streaming.

Website: https://kordstudio.syntalixconsultancy.com

## What Kord does
- Accepts WAV, FLAC and AIFF, and phone formats: M4A, AAC, MP3, OGG and Opus. Compressed sources are detected and the highs are not over-brightened.
- Analyses loudness, dynamics, tonal balance and stereo width.
- A language model reads those measurements (never the audio) and describes what the master needs.
- A deterministic safety layer turns that into bounded processing settings. The AI cannot exceed the limits.
- Delivers a lossless master plus versions for Spotify (FLAC, -14 LUFS), Apple Music (WAV, -16 LUFS), club play and broadcast (WAV, -24 LUFS), with peaks under -1 dBTP.

## Mastering styles built for Indian music
- Hindustani and Carnatic classical: -16 to -14 LUFS, compression at most 1.5:1 with slow release, so the tanpura does not pump and tabla and mridangam keep their attack.
- Devotional (bhajan, kirtan, qawwali): -15 to -13 LUFS, gentle control at most 2:1, warm and close.
- Film and playback songs: -12 to -10 LUFS, vocal forward, harsh 2-5 kHz edges on bright high notes controlled.
- Bollywood, Punjabi and dance: -10 to -8 LUFS, punchy dhol and kick, mono sub.
- Fusion and indie: -13 to -10 LUFS, acoustic instrument realism with a modern finish.

## Files and privacy
- Working files are deleted about 10 minutes after you stop working on a track; finished masters are kept for up to 12 hours.

## Access
- Kord is in early access. Artists request access at https://kordstudio.syntalixconsultancy.com/access-request and are onboarded personally.
